states.name: Root position
states.aria:
- 'table "A minor: root position, first inversion, and second inversion"':
  - caption: "A minor: root position, first inversion, and second inversion"
  - rowgroup:
    - row "Position Symbol Notes, low to high Bass":
      - columnheader "Position"
      - columnheader "Symbol"
      - columnheader "Notes, low to high"
      - columnheader "Bass"
  - rowgroup:
    - row "Root position , current selection Am A3–C4–E4 A3":
      - cell "Root position , current selection"
      - cell "Am"
      - cell "A3–C4–E4"
      - cell "A3"
    - row "First inversion Am/C C4–E4–A4 C4":
      - cell "First inversion"
      - cell "Am/C"
      - cell "C4–E4–A4"
      - cell "C4"
    - row "Second inversion Am/E E4–A4–C5 E4":
      - cell "Second inversion"
      - cell "Am/E"
      - cell "E4–A4–C5"
      - cell "E4"
